# Introduction

This document transforms a dataset that is not in the CWP format into the CWP format:
it first changes the structure of the data, then maps its codes to the CWP code lists.
It is generated from the function `gta_rawdata_wcpfc_catch_ps()` (`R/core/rawdata_wcpfc_catch_ps.R`), the code that the Global Tuna Atlas workflow runs.

The raw dataset is read from the `data/` folder next to this document, which holds the first
lines of each file under the name given by the tRFMO at export (this name may change).
A summary of the mapping is given at the end; the results are saved in the same folder.

*Knit the document from the repository (here::here() locates its root), or run it chunk by chunk.*

# The function


Converts the WCPFC purse seine catch dataset (5 degrees, monthly; file named
`WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM.csv` at the source) to the harmonized data structure
of the Tuna Atlas.

@param data The raw WCPFC dataset: a data frame or the path to the CSV file.
@return The harmonized catches: one row per fishing fleet, gear, period,
  area, fishing mode and species, with `source_authority`, `measurement`,
  `measurement_type`, `measurement_unit`, `measurement_value` and
  `measurement_processing_level`.

@details Input data sample:
\preformatted{
YY MM LAT5 LON5 DAYS SETS_UNA SETS_LOG ... SKJ_C_UNA YFT_C_UNA BET_C_UNA OTH_C_UNA ...
1967  2  30N 135E    0        0        0 ...         0         0         0         0 ...
}
Output data sample:
\preformatted{
fishing_fleet gear_type time_start time_end geographic_identifier fishing_mode species ...
ALL           S         1970-01-01 1970-02-01 6100135             LOG          BET     ...
}

@seealso \code{WCPFC_CE_catches_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD} (R/sardara_functions).
@author Paul Taconet, IRD \email{paul.taconet@ird.fr}
@author Bastien Grasset, IRD \email{bastien.grasset@ird.fr}

```{r}
# Packages the function uses unqualified, attached as in the workflow
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(reshape2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readxl) })
source(here::here('R/core/gta_data.R'))
gta_rawdata_wcpfc_catch_ps <- function(data) {
  DF <- gta_data(data, reader = gta_read_csv_utf8)

  ## Catches: reach the catches pivot data structure
  # - to upper colnames
  # - remove the CWP grid code
  colnames(DF) <- toupper(colnames(DF))
  DF$CWP_GRID <- NULL

  DF <- tidyr::gather(DF, variable, value, -c(colnames(DF[1:10])))

  DF <- dplyr::filter(DF, !value %in% 0)
  DF <- dplyr::filter(DF, !is.na(value))
  DF$variable <- as.character(DF$variable)
  colnames(DF)[which(colnames(DF) == "variable")] <- "Species"
  DF$School <- substr(DF$Species, 7, nchar(DF$Species))
  DF$Species <- sub("_C_UNA", "", DF$Species)
  DF$Species <- sub("_C_LOG", "", DF$Species)
  DF$Species <- sub("_C_DFAD", "", DF$Species)
  DF$Species <- sub("_C_AFAD", "", DF$Species)
  DF$Species <- sub("_C_OTH", "", DF$Species)
  DF$CatchUnits <- "t"
  DF$EffortUnits <- colnames(DF[5])
  colnames(DF)[5] <- "Effort"
  catches_pivot_WCPFC <- DF; rm(DF)

  # Gear
  catches_pivot_WCPFC$Gear <- "S"

  ## Reach the catches harmonized data structure
  colToKeep_captures <- c("FishingFleet", "Gear", "time_start", "time_end", "AreaName",
                          "School", "Species", "CatchType", "CatchUnits", "Catch")
  source(here::here("R/sardara_functions/WCPFC_CE_catches_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD.R"))
  catches <- WCPFC_CE_catches_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD(catches_pivot_WCPFC, colToKeep_captures)

  colnames(catches) <- c("fishing_fleet", "gear_type", "time_start", "time_end",
                         "geographic_identifier", "fishing_mode", "species",
                         "measurement_type", "measurement_unit", "measurement_value")
  catches$source_authority <- "WCPFC"
  catches$measurement_type <- "RC" # Retained catches
  catches$measurement <- "catch"
  catches$measurement_processing_level <- "raised"
  catches$time_start <- as.Date(catches$time_start)
  catches$time_end <- as.Date(catches$time_end)
  catches
}
```

# Harmonisation

```{r}
path_to_raw_dataset <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'catch', 'ps', 'data', 'WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM.csv')
georef_dataset <- gta_rawdata_wcpfc_catch_ps(path_to_raw_dataset)
write.csv(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'catch', 'ps', 'data', 'WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM_harmonized.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Mapping to the CWP code lists

```{r}
source(here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization/map_codelists_no_DB.R'))
fact <- "catch"
mapping_codelist <- map_codelists_no_DB(fact, dataset_to_map = georef_dataset, mapping_keep_src_code = FALSE, summary_mapping = TRUE, source_authority_to_map = c("IATTC", "CCSBT", "WCPFC"))
```

Unmapped values, then the results:

```{r}
georef_dataset <- mapping_codelist$dataset_mapped %>% dplyr::mutate(fishing_fleet = ifelse(fishing_fleet == 'UNK', 'NEI', fishing_fleet), gear_type = ifelse(gear_type == 'UNK', '99.9', gear_type))
# The summaries are NULL when nothing was mapped (e.g. tRFMOs not in source_authority_to_map)
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'catch', 'ps', 'data', 'WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM_recap_mapping.csv'))
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'catch', 'ps', 'data', 'WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM_not_mapped_total.csv'))
data.table::fwrite(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'catch', 'ps', 'data', 'WCPFC_S_PUBLIC_BY_YY_MM_CWP_dataset.csv'))
head(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)
```
